presets.name: Bare
presets.description: The top is the style's one optional piece and it appears on three of four seeds. Without it a set is seven shoulder lines against five head shapes, which is the plainest thing the style draws.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.description: The whole bust is a single fill, so a monochrome set here is two colors and nothing else: the ink and the ground behind it.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.description: A filled silhouette is the kind of drawing that loses nothing without color. Useful for a print stylesheet or anywhere color would carry meaning it should not.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One indigo on its own pale tint.
presets.description: Ink and ground take the same hue at two lightnesses, which is the smallest palette the style can be given.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty inks instead of the shipped eleven.
presets.description: The shipped inks are already restrained. These go one step further toward grey, which suits a comment thread where a dozen busts appear in a column.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Silhouettes past anything the style ships.
presets.description: The same lever the other way, on a near black ground. A filled shape at this saturation stops reading as a person and starts reading as a sign, which is the point.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: Changes only what the bust sits on. The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.summary: Saturated grounds behind a dark bust.
presets.description: Louder than the shipped set and pushed toward the primaries. The inks are dark enough to hold their edge on top of it.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The silhouette and the ground trade places, so the shape is what the light lands on.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the bust.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.summary: A hat or a hairstyle on everyone.
presets.description: Thirteen tops, all of them merged into the head rather than laid on top of it. At full probability they carry most of what separates one avatar from the next.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in, so the shoulders run past the edge.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. Cropping in leaves the head and the top, which is where the style puts its variation anyway.
